messages:
Lena (partnerships): Quick sync — need to lock down SI co-sell routing for the Dell/TPG engagement. Open questions: 1) warm vs cold lead rules, 2) HubSpot tagging + SFDC territory mapping, 3) who can approve joint announcements and timelines. Can we decide by EOD tomorrow? :clock1:
AJ (sales): +1. For clarity: Dell pre-qualified accounts should go to AE first, SI-sourced opportunities get partner credit. How are we defining "pre-qualified"?
Mike (AE): Suggestion: pre-qualified = intro + discovery call completed. If SI passes only email intro, route to AE SDR queue. If SI passes discovery notes and pain -> AE directly.
Tara (solutions): Agree. Also need a central account mapping sheet so we don't double-touch. I made a quick mapping in the partnership drive: https://drive.google.com/partnerships/dell-tpg-mapping
Priya (revops): Put the sheet link here and we'll sync to HubSpot automated field. We'll add two fields: si_partner and si_originated_date. Also propose tag convention: si_partner:dell, si_partner:tpgglobal
IntegrationsBot: New sheet created at https://docs.google.com/... by Tara
AJ (sales): On crediting: propose 60/40 AE/SI credit for influenced closed deals where SI introduced and participated in closure. Need legal/finance sign-off.
Lena (partnerships): Noted. For announcements: marketing + legal + partner team approval. Timeline: align on messaging 2 weeks before publish.
Priya (revops): HubSpot rule (pseudo):
```
if source contains "SI" and si_partner not empty:
  set owner = mapping_table[si_partner]
  set tag = "si_partner:" + lower(si_partner)
  set lead_stage = "SI-engaged"
```
Mike (AE): Can we add a 72-hour hold: SI-owned leads should stay with SI for 72 hours to work before auto-reassign. Otherwise move to next AE in territory.
Tara (solutions): Also require SI to submit discovery template when handing off — reduces churn.
Lena (partnerships): Agreed. Action items:
- Priya: implement HubSpot fields + 72h automation by Fri (1768458000)
- Tara: drop discovery template in drive and link in sheet by Wed
- AJ & Mike: draft AE/SI crediting memo for legal/finance review by next Tue
- Lena: coordinate announcement approval flow and publish checklist
Everyone: react with :thumbsup: if OK or reply with concerns.
AJ (sales): :thumbsup:
Mike (AE): :thumbsup:
Priya (revops): will do
Tara (solutions): uploading template now
Lena (partnerships): thanks — we'll reconvene Thurs 10am PT to confirm rollouts
IntegrationsBot: Meeting created: Thu 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent
